summary: Mellowbrook is a cell-based multiplayer fantasy RPG with OSRS skills and a separate third-person class-combat mode. Shared scripts and registries connect movement, combat, travel, HUD and creator tools; its Mellowbrook starter town joins authored landmarks and meadow paths with a softened relief terrain, while satellite zones use their own terrain contracts and authored cells.
places: places/main/ - Mellowbrook starter town: terrain marks, home pond and northern mountain/waterfall, town and meadow cells; Buddha garden has six hidden songbirds animated and managed by scripts/buddha-birds.js.
places/zone-summer/ - Sunreach Vale summer zone; terrain contract and authored cells build the valley and landmarks.
places/zone-autumn/, zone-spring/, zone-winter/, zone-swamp/ - seasonal satellite zones with terrain scripts and multi-cell authored scenes.
places/zone-road/ and places/zone-village/ - Old Road and Thistledown satellite places with authored landmark cells and terrain contracts.
places/zone-caves/, zone-city/, zone-creatures/, zone-desert/, zone-harbor/ - portal-linked places, each with a home cell.
roots: world.config.yaml - global inputs/actions and world configuration root.
templates/player.js - player behavior-chain entry; scripts/player.js owns movement intent and velocity.
templates/camera.js - camera behavior entry, routed to orbit, classic or editor rig.
places/main/config.yaml and places/main/cells/*.scene - starter terrain, atmosphere, terrain marks and authored placement roots, including the Buddha statue, six bird entities and bird manager.
places/zone-*/config.yaml and cells - satellite terrain contracts and authored scene roots.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - main terrain entry: town relief below z=150 and generated back range north of it.
shared: scripts/lib/locomotion-core.js - locomotion shared by player control and humanoid form/gait behavior.
scripts/lib/plates-hud.js and ui/hud/cursors.js - enemy/quest plate and contextual cursor presentation; cursor reads player.state.hover and quest registries.
scripts/lib/data/monsters.js and scripts/lib/data/quests.js - monster/combat/loot and quest definitions reused by combat, AI, NPC and HUD systems.
scripts/lib/data/stones.js - STONES, ZONES and zoneById used by portal/hearth handler and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/terrain-editor.js - TE, tools, layers and terrain-editor palettes/brush recipes shared with terrain-editor-core.js.
scripts/lib/data/prefabs-library.js and scripts/lib/asset-browser.js - creator prefab catalog and searchable asset browser.
scripts/lib/data/class-spells.js, class-sigs.js and spell-desc.js - class spell kit, visual signature and tooltip data consumed by class combat/HUD.
notableExports: scripts/lib/data/terrain-editor.js - exports TE, TOOLS, GROUPS, LAYERS, WET, BIOME, FOLIAGE, LAYER_TEX, ALL_LAYERS and POND.
scripts/terrain-editor-core.js - exports onInput; implements terrain-editor tools including Pond Paint and Path Paint.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - exports RANGE, spurHeight, rangeHeight, townRelief, heightAt and materialAt for Mellowbrook terrain.
scripts/lib/data/stones.js - exports STONES, ZONES, zoneById; scripts/stones-player.js - exports onInput, update; ui/hud/stones.js - exports stoneSlot, stonesHud.
scripts/zone-road-ground.js - exports ROOMS, ROAD, GORGE, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/zone-village-ground.js - exports ROOMS, STREAM, heightAt, materialAt.

scripts/zone-winter-ground.js and scripts/zone-spring-ground.js - export room/terrain contracts and heightAt/materialAt; summer, swamp and autumn ground scripts export terrain contracts and heightAt/materialAt.
scripts/lib/data/monsters.js - exports monster, attack, drop, site and death registries; scripts/lib/data/quests.js - exports QUESTS, KILL_QUESTS, QUEST_OF_NPC, QUEST_MARK.
scripts/buddha-birds.js - exports update; scripts/gen/songbird.js - exports skeleton, geometry and collider for configurable procedural birds.
ownership: scripts/player.js - movement intent/velocity; player.state.tp owns class-mode XP, level, talents and per-class talent state.
OSRS handlers (skills-player.js, combat-player.js, prayer-player.js, magic-player.js, equip-player.js, spellbook-player.js) - OSRS skills, XP, stamina, combat and equipment state.
scripts/class-cast-player.js - class-mode casts, cooldowns, hits/heals/status effects and class combat state.
scripts/stones-player.js - player.state.stoneCast and hearthCd; channel lifecycle and destination crossing.
scripts/ed-camp.js and scripts/monster.js - camp membership/spawns and individual enemy AI, health, combat, death and respawn.
scripts/quest-player.js - player quest progress and kill counters; scripts/quest-giver.js - NPC offer interaction.
Zone config/ground scripts own terrain and atmosphere contracts; scene cells own authored placements; data registries own definitions, not runtime player state.
scripts/terrain-editor-core.js - player.state.te editor view/history and undo/redo; terrain marks/scatter beds persist edits in place terrain data.
flows: world.config.yaml input/actions → templates/player.js behavior chain → scripts/player.js movement intent/velocity → humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/lib/locomotion-core.js gait/seat blending.
templates/camera.js → scripts/camera-router.js → orbit/classic/editor rig; player.state.settings.camStyle selects the configured view.
Main gate state.to (legacy state.link accepted) → scripts/zone-gate.js onTriggerEnter → +zone-<name>#zhome-<name>; satellite return gate → +main#zgate-<name>.
Zone config.yaml → shared terrain interface and zone-specific heightAt/materialAt; config binds materials, vegetation, paths/marks and atmosphere.
zone-road config and zone-road-ground.js ROOMS/ROAD/GORGE → Old Road terrain and landmark cells; village config and ground ROOMS/STREAM → Thistledown terrain and cells.
Zone spring/winter configs and ground scripts → brook/meadow and pass/lake terrain contracts → authored cells; other zone ground scripts similarly define each zone's terrain.
art/summer-zone.mjs and art/summer-detail.mjs → baked sv-/svd- datasets → places/zone-summer/cells; scripted props use scripts/gen/sv-props.js.

world.config.yaml hearth/stonePortal/stoneCancel + templates/player.js → scripts/stones-player.js; it reads STONES/ZONES from scripts/lib/data/stones.js, writes stoneCast/hearthCd and teleports or crosses to an anchor.
ui/hud/stones.js → hudHearth/hudPortalWin/hudPortalGo in ui.js → hearth/stonePortal actions; classbar A1/A2 slots invoke HUD and show channel/cooldown.
places/main/config.yaml pond lake, bowl marks and pond-point/pond-bulge flatten marks → main terrain sampling; cells around x-1z0/x-1z1/x0z1 dress pond banks and pier.
Main config terrain marks → scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js sampling; mtnd-falls-bowl flatten and mtnd-falls-pool lake define the waterfall splash basin, with cells x0z3 dressing the crag.

places/main/cells/x0z0.scene six buddha-bird tagged songbirds + buddha-birds behavior → scripts/buddha-birds.js; it raycasts configured Buddha perch points, plays anim/songbird.yml clips and drives arrival, perching, chirps and departure.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/ed-history.js, ed-gizmo.js, build-tool.js, terrain-editor.js, ed-logic.js, ed-ai.js, ed-scatter.js and ed-outliner.js - editor shells load matching *-core.js implementations and share creator-tool services.
scripts/player.js plus humanoid-locomotion.js / scripts/lib/locomotion-core.js - ordered movement controller and complementary form-aware gait/heading behavior.

scripts/combat-player.js, class-cast-player.js, skills-player.js, prayer-player.js, magic-player.js, equip-player.js and spellbook-player.js - connected RPG handlers separated by combat mode and varied by class/loadout.
scripts/camera.js, camera-classic.js and camera-editor.js - alternative camera rigs selected by camera-router.js; classic supports shoulder and first-person views.
scripts/lib/cast-anim.js and class spell data - cast movement/visuals and named spell signatures reused by spell and cast kind.
scripts/ed-camp.js, scripts/monster.js and scripts/lib/data/monsters.js - camp-managed and individually placed enemies share AI/stat rows, varied by composition and kind.
scripts/quest-giver.js, scripts/quest-player.js, scripts/lib/data/quests.js, scripts/lib/plates-hud.js and ui/hud/cursors.js - quest offers/progress/turn-ins/status vary by NPC and player progress.

scripts/tex-*.js, scripts/gen/* and zone-ground scripts - reusable textures, generated prefab/vegetation/prop definitions and terrain contracts vary by material, asset and landform; scripts/gen/songbird.js takes body/wing color parameters.
migrationNotes: Keep class mode separate from OSRS: class XP/level/talents use player.state.tp; OSRS skills, XP, stamina and skill-gated jumping remain OSRS-owned.
Class level is 1–30; XP is 4 per damage plus 25 per kill, xpToNext = 60·level^1.5, talent points begin at level 2 and tiers open at 0/5/10/15 spent.

Main heightAt adds townRelief only below z=150; its 4 m RELIEF mask is baked from placements, pond and plaza so built areas stay level; outside the grid it now blends to free terrain over 16 m, not an abrupt edge.

Main's generated mountain begins north of z=150; accessible spur is centered near x=5 and mtn-trail uses grade=true/maxGrade=0.2 with six flatten landings and an 85.91 m summit mark. The meadow rim eases over 70 m before the range takes over.
Waterfall basin uses flatten mtnd-falls-bowl at (-43,358), height 73.6, and lake mtnd-falls-pool level 74.5/radius 6.5; mountain-pass dressing spans main cells x0z1–x0z4 and x1z2.

Home pond lake stays centered (-100,92), radius 55, level -0.35 and zero depth; pond-point and pond-bulge flatten marks shape its grassy banks. Buddha birds depend on the tagged entities in x0z0.scene, statue id pf-buddha-statue-127n5, matching PERCHES in scripts/buddha-birds.js, and clip names in anim/songbird.yml.
